name: UIC Department of Psychiatry 17th Annual Research Forum (Extravaganza) 2026
organizer: Department of Psychiatry, University of Illinois College of Medicine (UIC)
venue: COMRB Moss Auditorium, 909 S. Wolcott Ave, Chicago, IL
description: The Department of Psychiatry's annual Research Forum, known informally as the Extravaganza, is a Grand Rounds poster session in which department faculty, residents, fellows and students present psychiatric research for a competitive poster award. The 17th annual edition is scheduled for October 7, 2026, with abstract submissions opening September 2, 2026.
